ABSTRACT
A cabin management apparatus according to the present disclosure is a
cabin management apparatus configured to manage a cabin of a vehicle, the cabin management apparatus including a communication interface, an output
interface, and a controller, wherein the controller is configured to receive, by the communication interface, emergency stop information for the vehicle, receive, by the communication interface, the degree of automated controllability over a door of the vehicle, and provide, by the output interface based on the emergency stop information, a different notification depending on
the degree of automated controllability over the door.
